title: UA gear: clearer choices, safer sizing
lede: Colors edit the actual pick, sizing follows the item, and the catalog stays visible as the allowance changes.

sections.heading: Matched before and after
sections.note: Baseline preserves the prior uncommitted design and Standard issue wording. Same synthetic staff fixture, clock, viewport, and page shell; this is not authenticated persistence proof.

pairs.title: Browse the full catalog
pairs.beforeCap: Allowance filtering started on and could hide products as picks changed.
pairs.afterCap: The full catalog stays visible by default; Within my allowance is optional.

pairs.title: Change the selected color
pairs.beforeCap: Review let staff change sizes and quantities but could not change colors.
pairs.afterCap: The color control edits the saved SKU, preserving size and quantity. Duplicate selections block saving.

pairs.title: Choose the right hat size
pairs.beforeCap: Stretch Fit caps were automatically treated as one size.
pairs.afterCap: Fitted hats require an item-specific size; missing selections are explained in the list and review.

changes.h: Size each kind of gear correctly
changes.was: Shoes could save without sizes, shirts supplied defaults for pants, and all hats were one size.
changes.now: Shoes and fitted hats require sizes. Pants and base layers start without shirt defaults. Slides use whole-size options and matching US profile systems. Drive Pant uses even waist sizes.

changes.was: Invalid old sizes could appear valid.
changes.now: Saved sizes remain visible but unavailable item sizes must be corrected. Color changes preserve quantity and size, with duplicate detection.

verification: 53 focused pricing and route tests pass; 8 sizing/default regressions fail on the isolated pre-change source.
11 Chromium checks pass, including color payloads, duplicate feedback, optional filtering, and item sizing.
Application-only build and changed-file lint pass. TypeScript reports only the same two existing errors in unrelated iOS test helpers.
notes: No commit, push, deployment, or database changes.
Icon Lo size range is verified, but its source does not identify the US size system. The user suspects men’s sizing; automatic defaults remain off until confirmed.

Exact sizing sources: FW27_AE_Headwear_Wisconsin.pdf pages 2, 6, 9; Wisconsin Licensed Footwear.pdf page 1; FW27 Wisconsin Pinnacle B2B.pdf (6021743). All are supplied local UA documents in Downloads.
Authenticated preview remains unavailable: this branch needs an authorized PR and its own managed preview.
